business_problem: Trillet needed to automate complex enterprise calls in sensitive industries, but earlier model choices produced unreliable answers and its fragmented infrastructure made it hard to scale voice workflows predictably and cost-effectively.
solution_summary: Trillet moved its voice application layer to Google Cloud so conversational automation could be both predictable and scalable. Gemini in Vertex AI became the core reasoning engine, allowing the team to run with near-zero model freedom for high-stakes healthcare and enterprise interactions while still maintaining large context and fast responses. The models cross-reference live clinic databases and scheduling rules to formulate answers, which sharply reduced erroneous appointment responses compared with earlier LLM attempts. Google Kubernetes Engine and Cloud Load Balancing provide the elastic runtime needed to absorb large call spikes, while the unified Google Cloud stack removes the operational overhead of a fragmented black-box setup. This architecture lets Trillet orchestrate thousands of calls simultaneously, keep error rates below one percent, and combine real-time data access with strict AI control in a way that is suitable for regulated customer interactions.

solution_components.name: Vertex AI
solution_components.role: Hosts Trillet's conversational AI workflows and enforces the controlled, low-variance reasoning needed for sensitive call handling.

solution_components.name: Gemini
solution_components.role: Cross-references user requests against live databases and scheduling rules to produce accurate call responses.

solution_components.name: Google Kubernetes Engine
solution_components.role: Scales the voice application layer to handle thousands of calls and traffic spikes without manual intervention.

solution_components.name: Cloud Load Balancing
solution_components.role: Distributes incoming call workload across the runtime environment.

data_flow: Caller requests enter through Cloud Load Balancing into services on GKE, where Gemini models on Vertex AI validate the request against live clinic data and scheduling rules. The resulting response is returned to the caller or escalated if needed, while the platform elastically scales for spikes in call volume.
business_outcome: Trillet cut infrastructure cost, reduced escalations and error rates, and turned Google Cloud into a production voice layer that can automate most complex enterprise calls while maintaining the reliability demanded by sensitive industries.
